utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Last I heard, the repair drive moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center. I’m still checking if anything else changed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Nell — Sunday at the community center is the plan, and I’m keeping it tight unless I hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll pass along Sunday at the community center as the confirmed plan unless I hear a change.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I still need the source and written confirmation before I’ll sign off—what exactly is wrong with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Nice, that’s the plan then — Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep repeating it. If you’ve got the source and the repair list, send it my way and I’ll spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep it moving: Sunday at the community center, and I’ll spread the word as soon as I have the source and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Right, so it’s Sunday at the community center now — what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’d start with the biggest busted stuff first—bring me a list or point me at the pile, and I’ll get hands-on.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll round up the biggest broken stuff and bring you the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday at the community center. Come then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, Sunday at the community center — I’ll come then. Thanks for keeping me straight.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Bring what you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I still need the parts list source in writing before I can sign off. Once that’s confirmed, I’ll take another look.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That makes sense — I’ll get the parts list source in writing and confirm the latest repair details before we move ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — send it over in writing, and I’ll review it once I can verify the source.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sunday at the community center should work if it fits my 12:30 to 2:00 window—I just need to leave by 2:10 for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That fits your window nicely, Faye — I’ve noted the 12:30 to 2:00 timing and your 2:10 pickup departure without changing the rest of the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, then I’m in for that window. Just keep me posted if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I still need the confirmed repair list, who’s handling each item, and the locked-in costs—no estimates. Also confirm the drive is Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Confirmed: the drive is Sunday at the community center. I don’t have a locked-in repair list, assigned handlers, or verified costs yet, so I won’t invent them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Then send me the confirmed list as soon as you have it. I’m not sharing anything until the assignments and costs are locked down.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s keep the repair drive on Sunday at the community center, and I’d like the confirmed list of tasks first so I can assign things cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll keep it simple. Send the confirmed task list when it’s ready, and I’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — I’m sticking with Sunday at the community center. Once I have the confirmed task list, I’ll assign everything from there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Right — the repair drive’s on Sunday at the community center now. What do you want me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard folks are bringing tools and spare parts today, and a few hands are already lined up to help. If you can, just keep the confirmed list and who’s handling what straight.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll keep the confirmed list straight and track who’s handling what.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. What’s left to assign, and what do you want me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep the Sunday community center plan fixed. You take the final checks and calibration, and I’ll keep the rest steady.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll handle the final checks and calibration, and keep the Sunday community center plan fixed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still catching up, but I think the repair drive is Sunday at the community center. I’ll double-check and let you know if anything’s changed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s the part I’m sure of too: Sunday at the community center. I’d wait on anything else until it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll wait on the rest and check for the latest before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Right, the repair drive got bumped to Sunday at the community center — that part’s set. I’m still chasing the written parts list confirmation, though.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it — I’ll hold the update to Sunday at the community center and wait on the written parts list before I post anything else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa — that’s perfect. I’ll keep nudging for the written parts list and send it along as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got the repair drive as Sunday at the community center; if you have the exact time or list, please send it in writing and I’ll add it carefully.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, Sunday at the community center is still the plan — send me the exact time and list in writing, and I’ll repeat it around.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That works for me; I’ll keep Sunday at the community center noted and wait for the exact time and list in writing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still a bit behind, but I’ll check the latest repair drive details and pass them along as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that — I’ve only heard it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, but I’m not sure about anything else yet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that matches what I’d heard too — I’ll double-check the rest and let you know if anything changed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — Sunday at the community center. Just send me the next fix when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Next fix: send me the repair list, and I’ll confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll send the repair list when I’m between trips.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, the repair drive’s Sunday at the community center now—what do you need me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Right, Sunday at the community center it is. Let me know the first task, and I’ll keep it in order.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll keep it in order too. What’s the first thing you want me on?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s now Sunday at the community center, and folks are already bringing tools and spare parts. Sounds like people are lining up to help, but the confirmed list and costs still need to be locked in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds right, but I’d like the confirmed list and costs before we move ahead. If you have the latest details, send them my way and I’ll double-check them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t got the final list yet, just that Sunday at the community center is set and people are bringing tools and spare parts. I’ll pass along the confirmed items and costs as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sunday at the community center still works for me, as long as we keep it between 12:30 and 2:00. I have to head out by 2:10 for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sunday at the community center, 12:30 to 2:00—confirmed. What’s the locked-in repair list and who’s assigned to each item?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can send the repair list, but I’ll need the final assignments to keep it moving. As long as everything stays within 12:30 to 2:00, I’m good.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — Sunday at the community center. Tell me what needs fixing first, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: First up, let’s prioritize the most urgent repairs so we can keep things moving smoothly on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’m just catching up, so point me to the most urgent repair and I’ll help get it around.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll bring my tools and jump in wherever you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you send me the confirmed parts list in writing before I sign off? I still need a source for it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — I’ll write up the confirmed parts list and send it over before you sign off. If I’m missing anything, I’ll track it down fast.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word that the repair drive is Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep sharing that the repair drive is Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You bet — I’ll keep pushing the Sunday-at-the-community-center version and get more folks there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now, and I’ll keep the update clear and unchanged.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, thanks for keeping it clear — Sunday at the community center it is. I’ll pass that along, and we still need that parts list in writing for Kira.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send the parts list in writing for Kira and keep everything matched to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Sunday at the community center — I think Leo’s sorting the repairs, but I’m still a bit fuzzy on the list. If you’ve got the confirmed fixes, I’ll gladly help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll confirm the repair list with Leo and send out the Sunday community center update once I’ve got it locked in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rosa — just let me know once Leo confirms the repairs, and I’ll pass along the Sunday community center update.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — the repair drive’s now Sunday at the community center. What assignments are still open, and what do you want me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m only sure the drive is Sunday at the community center. The rest should wait until it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll hold off on assignments until it’s confirmed, and I’ll just pass along the Sunday at the community center update for now.
